data.one_liner: A virtual keyboard widget with customizable layouts for devices lacking physical keyboards.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable virtual keyboard widget written in Dart with support for numeric, alphanumeric, and custom layouts. It handles key press callbacks and special actions like backspace, return, shift, and space without requiring native code dependencies.
use_when: Building kiosk or ATM interfaces that run on touchscreens without native keyboards
Creating custom on-screen keyboards with tailored layouts and key arrangements
avoid_when: Relying on built-in OS software keyboards for standard mobile text input
strengths: No native code dependencies, pure Dart implementation
Allows custom layouts and custom key strings
Supports numeric, alphanumeric, and custom keyboard types
weaknesses: Switch Language button functionality is not working out of the box according to documentation
data.minimal_example:
Container(
  color: Colors.grey,
  child: VirtualKeyboard(
    height: 350,
    width: 600,
    textColor: Colors.white,
    fontSize: 20,
    type: VirtualKeyboardType.Custom,
    keys: const [
      ["T", "E", "S", "T"],
      ["RETURN", "SHIFT", "BACKSPACE", "SPACE"],
    ],
    onKeyPress: (key) => print(key.text),
  ),
)
